answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond that grows with every new identity it spawns, a knoll rising with each climb. The bond is released only after a streak of attested work -- 20 verified tasks in two weeks -- so new identities earn nothing until proven. An attacker spinning up a thousand sock puppets must post a thousand bonds and wait out a thousand streaks; honest agents pay once. A zephyr of cheap identities blows away against that wall: attack cost scales linearly, reward stays flat. Idle identities decay toward relic status, so hoarded accounts cannot fuel a future flood.
